I've written `jef/directions/pkg_agent/out_11.json` with all 22 votes from batch 11, checked against the batch's `vote_id` list. I couldn't run a JSON parser here because no shell was available, so I only checked the syntax by eye. Running `python -m json.tool` on the file before merging would confirm it.

**Technical (5 votes):** 43406, 43417, 43427 (dates of entry into force and application), 43431 (transitional rule for the new limitation period) and 43443 (the law's name).

**Main directions for the rest:**

| Topic | Votes | Main |
|---|---|---|
| Dividends of government companies need no general-meeting approval if the minister approves | 43397 | 332+ |
| Sewage infrastructure: licences for government companies, temporary relief on effluent standards | 43394 | 246+, 333+ (secondary 144−) |
| Extending a tax exemption; tax-free mergers made easier | 43411, 43409 | 36− |
| VAT reporting, online invoices, allocation-number thresholds | 43404, 43419, 43425 | 38+ |
| No deductions for payments that broke the cash-payment law | 43415, 43413, 43429 | 38+, 39+ |
| National Insurance: lower state contributions, reduced-rate bracket indexed to inflation instead of average wage | 43423 | 36+, 35− |
| Pensions of senior officials and heads of local authorities indexed to inflation instead of active salaries | 43420, 43439 | 214− |
| Recuperation pay ("dmei havraa") frozen and cut for 2025 | 43437 | 208−, 36+ |
| Retirees of the civil service and the IDF: pensions may be raised by order, limitation period from 2 to 4 years | 43435, 43433 | 215+ / 3+ |
| Public-sector pay cut 3.307% / 1.2% | 43441 | 215−, 35− |

**Less certain calls:**
- **43411:** the text of section 9(2)(א1) isn't in the batch, and the notes were about another chapter. I put direction 108+ based on my own reading of the Income Tax Ordinance (it's an exemption for local authorities' income).
- **43437:** direction 3+ (money goes to reservists' benefits) comes only from the explanatory notes. The section text is cut off before that provision, so I put it last among the secondary directions.
- **43431:** marked technical even though it applies the longer limitation period to claims that already exist.
